data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): The structural-boundary suite MUST also assert the marker CONSUMPTION MECHANISM, because dso:task-decomposer is prohibited from ticket/shell access and CANNOT self-fetch the MIGRATION_CLASS comment. Add assertions that: (a) task-decomposer.md's Inputs section declares a {migration-marker} placeholder (marker arrives as a verbatim passed-in input block, like {testing-mode}/{selected-approach}); (b) the Migration-Class Pair Emission section instructs parsing migration-class from the PASSED-IN arg, NEVER fetching from the ticket; (c) SKILL.md Step 3 'Pass the following as task arguments' list includes a {migration-marker} bullet sourced from the LAST MIGRATION_CLASS: comment on the story. Verify: grep -q 'migration-marker' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh
